marketing_description: The DeWALT DCB2108-2 20 V MAX XR battery pack features a 8 Ah lithium-ion battery chemistry and delivers power for demanding applications. Engineered with tabless cell technology for a longer lifespan, this battery also includes an integrated LED state-of-charge indicator to help avoid interruptions. This pack includes 2 batteries, designed for use with DeWALT 20 V MAX tools.
